features: WORKS WITHOUT WIFI — ANY 4G SIM: No home broadband required. Insert any 4G SIM (Jio, Airtel, Vi, BSNL) and the camera connects instantly — perfect for farms, shops, sites, and remote locations.
PAN AND TILT INDOOR COVERAGE: 3MP motorised camera rotates to cover your entire indoor space — control direction from your phone in real-time from anywhere.

COLOUR NIGHT VISION UP TO 10 METRES: Maizic Smarthome's full-colour night vision identifies faces, clothing colours, and vehicle number plates clearly even in complete darkness — far superior to black-and-white IR-only cameras.

AI MOTION DETECTION WITH INSTANT ALERTS: Smart human-detection sends real-time push notifications to your phone the moment movement is detected — filtering false alarms from animals or trees, 24 hours a day.
TWO-WAY AUDIO: Built-in microphone and speaker let you hear and speak through the camera using the app — warn intruders, communicate with family, or answer visitors from anywhere in India.
